proof_body:
by
  intro a b x hab
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith), abs_of_neg (by linarith)] at h
      linarith
    · by_contra hgt
      push_neg at hgt
      rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith), abs_of_pos (by linarith)] at h
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
    ring
target_source: ∀ a b x : ℝ, a ≤ b → (|x - a| + |x - b| = b - a ↔ a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b)
